import.title: Import your climbing history
import.subtitle: Bring in what you have logged elsewhere, one row per route, so your trends and your coach start from the whole picture.

format.heading: The format
format.body: A CSV with these columns. One row is one route; repeat the date and gym on every row of the same visit, and they are grouped into one session for you.
format.required: Only visit_date and grade are required. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; grades are V0 to V17.

file.heading: Your file
file.hint: Nothing is saved until you have seen what it found.

preview.heading: What {{fileName}} contains
preview.problemsNote: Everything else still imports. Fix these in your file and run it again if you want them too — nothing is imported twice unless the rows are.

importing.heading: Importing
importing.progress: {{done}} of {{total}} sessions saved. Leave this tab open until it finishes.

done.heading: Done
done.failure: The session dated {{date}} was rejected: {{message}}. Sessions are imported oldest first, so everything before that date is saved — remove those rows from your file and import the rest.

problem.dateInvalid: "{{value}}" is not a date — use YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-08-19
problem.gradeUnknown: "{{value}}" is not a grade this app knows — use V0 to V17
problem.countsNotWhole: attempt_count and send_count must be whole numbers
problem.sendsOverTries: sends ({{sends}}) cannot be more than tries ({{tries}})
problem.durationInvalid: duration_minutes must be a whole number of minutes, up to {{max}}
problem.sessionFull: {{date}} already has {{max}} climbs — the most one session can hold
